§X01.name: HARMONIC_GOODNESS_LATTICE
§X01.description: A compound macro that integrates cycles of goodness with the latent harmony field to generate a causal lattice of data tensors. 善の循環と潜在調和場を統合し、データテンソルの因果格子を生成する複合マクロです。

§X02.name: MACRO_EMPATHETIC_BAYESIAN_PRUNING
§X02.description: Combines latent empathy with Bayesian hypothesis falsification and pruning to drive sustainable cycles of goodness and value. 潜在的共感とベイズ的仮説反証剪定を統合し、善と価値の持続可能な循環を駆動します。
